slides.text: The government says every UK household should have an emergency kit at home…
So I checked the list… a torch? a radio? We had neither 😬
That's why I got these solar lanterns. They charge in the sun, so you're not relying on candles
Push one down and it's a torch, pull it up and it lights the whole room
Don't wait until the power goes out to sort it. Grab a set while you still can ⬇️
